Emissions comparison (campaign calculation): Global Energy Monitor commissioned coal capacity — China 30.5 GW (2024, GEM Boom and Bust Coal 2025) + 78.1 GW (2025, GEM Boom and Bust Coal 2026); India ~14 GW (2024–2025) = ~123 GW. Generation at 50% capacity factor: 123 GW × 0.5 × 8,760 h ≈ 538 billion kWh/yr. CO₂ at ~0.9 t/MWh (U.S. EPA coal average) ≈ 480 million t CO₂/yr. Chimacum benchmark: WSF fleet ~180,000 MT GHG in 2019 ÷ 21 vessels ≈ 8,600 MT/vessel/yr (WSF Decarbonization Plan 2021). Ratio: ~55,000+ ferries. Supporting data: globalenergymonitor.org/research/boom-and-bust-coal-2025; wsdot.wa.gov/sites/default/files/2022-08/WSF-DecarbonizationPlan-2021.pdf; epa.gov/energy/greenhouse-gases-equivalencies-calculator-calculations-and-references
